description: Find CTIS trials whose authorised sites match an organisation name. OMS keys such as ORG-100011252 are not in the public search index; pass the organisation name. Emails and phone numbers are removed. Results are a sample of the newest matching overviews, not a full crawl.

maxTrials.description: Maximum full records to retrieve. Default 8.

query.description: Organisation name, or an ORG-/ORL- key.

name: find_trials_at_site
title: Find EU trials at a site
